clinical_intent: Evaluate the compliance of a brachytherapy program that treats patients using a single-channel vaginal cylinder applicator for all vaginal cancer cases regardless of tumor size or location. Discuss whether this approach meets the standard of care for brachytherapy, the limitations of a single-channel approach, and the equipment and training requirements for offering multi-channel applicator treatments.
